> A compact custom mini keyboard designed for productivity, shortcuts, and creative workflows. It features four mechanical switches and a rotary encoder in a sleek, space-saving layout. The custom-designed PCB and 3D-printed case give it a unique look while keeping the device portable and practical for everyday use. I don't need funding for this project because i have all the parts that i need at home.

### 2026-10-08 – Designed my Mini Hackpad PCB in KiCad: wired MX switches with diodes as a matrix, assigned footprints, routed traces and added the board outline. Problems: wrong footprints, crowded routing, and DRC c

**7h**

Designed my Mini Hackpad PCB in KiCad: wired MX switches with diodes as a matrix, assigned footprints, routed traces and added the board outline. Problems: wrong footprints, crowded routing, and DRC clearance errors I had to fix.
